source_identity.title: Free energy expansions of a conditional GinUE and large deviations of the smallest eigenvalue of the LUE
source_identity.acquired_version: arXiv:2402.18983v3, submitted 2025-05-15, PDF internally dated 2025-05-16; 43 pages
source_identity.version_limit: Only the acquired preprint scientifically reviewed. Publisher-final equality, other versions, and author adoption of proposed corrections not established.

summary: Critical O(1) Tracy-Widom argument uses the wrong size conversion; precritical moment prefactor is incompatible with the stated free-energy formula; printed refined RH construction has an uncancelled O(1/n) local pole. The last is a proof-construction defect, not a disproof of the unchanged scalar free-energy coefficient.

problems.statement: For the critical a_n scaling in(1.20), Proposition2.5 uses log F_TW(c^(-2/3)s). The exact duality has LUE dimension m=c*n, so the edge law quoted by the source instead gives limiting log F_TW(s).
problems.hypotheses: c>0 fixed, real s fixed, n GinUE particles, m=c*n LUE dimension, alpha=1/c. Select an integer subsequence when c*n is required integral. a_n=b-D*s*n^(-2/3)+O(n^(-4/3)), b=sqrt(c+1)-sqrt(c), D=b^(1/3)/(2*c^(1/6)*(c+1)^(1/6)).
derivation: B*delta^(2/3)=c^(-2/3), but the actual scale is (delta*m)^(2/3)=(delta*c*n)^(2/3). Hence y_n=s+O(n^(-2/3)); the missing factor c^(2/3) cancels c^(-2/3).
The quoted continuous edge limit gives logZ_n(a_n,c)-logZ_n(0,c)-c*n^2*a_n^2 -> logF_TW(s). Subtracting radial(3.6) from printed(2.17) gives logF_TW(c^(-2/3)s). All other O(1) terms match.
By(2.15), (logF_TW)'(s)=integral_s^infinity q(x)^2 dx>0; q is the real Hastings-McLeod solution with nonzero Airy asymptotic. Distinct arguments give distinct constants.
problems.counterexample: c=9/16,s=1,n=16k,m=9k,rectangular dimensions9k and25k,alpha=16/9,a_(16k)=1/2-15^(-1/3)*(16k)^(-2/3). Correct argument tends1; printed argument(16/9)^(2/3)>1. a_n>0 for allpositivek.
counterevidence: If N in standalone(6.9) is consistently the LUE dimension, that display can be valid; conversion is still required before the same N is used as GinUE size in(1.20)/(2.17).
c=1 or s=0 masks the discrepancy; neither settles all c,s. Unscaled eigenvalues/density normalization do not change exact duality dimensions.
Radial baseline agrees to O(1); O(n^-1) radial terms cannot remove an O(1) discrepancy.
Tail check(2.22) grouped with this issue: actual logF_TW(c^-2/3*s)=log2/24+zeta'(-1)-log|s|/8+logc/12-|s|^3/(12c^2)+O(|s|^-3) at fixedc.
problems.impact: The critical order-one statement is incompatible with the source's own duality and quoted soft-edge law. Major for the advertised O(1) result; not a rejection of fixed-phase asymptotics.
problems.correction_verification: With unchanged(1.20), replacing c^-2/3*s by s gives the verified limiting O(1) term conditional on the cited edge limit. The full O(n^-2/3) remainder rate and external universality theorem were not newly proved.
problems.repair_status: With unchanged(1.20), replacing c^-2/3*s by s gives the verified limiting O(1) term conditional on the cited edge limit. The full O(n^-2/3) remainder rate and external universality theorem were not newly proved.

problems.location: Theorem2.2,(2.9) p7; Theorem2.7,(2.32) p10; exact(1.8) and GinUE normalization(3.7) p15
problems.statement: The precritical characteristic-polynomial prefactor has (F(a)-1)^3 instead of (F(a)^2-1)^3 in its twenty-fourth-power denominator.
problems.hypotheses: Fixed strict precritical branch a>b,0<q<1,kappa>0,F(a)=1/q=w>1; exact moment identity(1.8), Euler characteristic1 in free-energy formula(2.6).
derivation: Divide Theorem2.2 by GinUE expansion(3.7). The n logn, n, logn, log2pi and zeta' constants cancel, requiring logG_pre=F_pre conditional on Theorem2.2.
Printed(2.32) instead has(w-1)^3; therefore printedG/exp(F_pre)=(w+1)^(1/8), a nonvanishing fixed factor which exp(O(1/n)) cannot absorb.
problems.counterexample: a=1,q=1/2,c=27/8,R=5/4,kappa=9/16,F(a)=2. The cubic q^6-[(a^2+4c+2)/(2a^2)]q^4+1/(2a^4)=0 and f(2)=1 hold; phase is strict precritical. Expected twenty-fourth power6912/4375, printed186624/4375; ratioG=3^(1/8). n divisibleby8 meets c*n integrality.
counterevidence: Actual source images5,7,10,15 inspected to fix the cubic, branch, exponent24, and denominator; not OCR inference.
The exact identity and cancellation eliminate a missing universal GinUE normalization as an explanation.
This proves internal incompatibility of the two stated main asymptotics; it is not an independent derivation of the full actual nonradial moment limit.
problems.impact: Incorrect constant relative to the paper's own free-energy formula in an advertised constant-accurate main moment theorem; Major.
problems.correction_verification: Replace (F(a)-1)^3 by (F(a)^2-1)^3. Exact algebra verifies consistency with(2.9); full asymptotic proof remains conditional on the free-energy theorem.
problems.repair_status: Replace (F(a)-1)^3 by (F(a)^2-1)^3. Exact algebra verifies consistency with(2.9); full asymptotic proof remains conditional on the free-energy theorem.

problems.statement: The two off-diagonal entries in the printed h11 lack a factor i. Consequently H1 in(5.30) has an uncancelled simple pole, contradicting the local holomorphy used in the refined RH proof.
problems.hypotheses: n=N orthogonal-polynomial degree and asymptotic size; fixed strict precritical a,c; q in(0,1),R,kappa>0. lambda=bar_beta=u-2i*rho,beta=u+2i*rho,u=Rq-kappa/q,rho=sqrt(R*kappa),source branch normalized at infinity.
derivation: Required simple-pole coefficient is i*C/(128*rho*n) times[[3-10i*rho*eta,i*(19+30i*rho*eta)/3],[i*(19+30i*rho*eta)/3,-3+10i*rho*eta]]. The printed off-diagonal entries omit that extra i.
Entire h12 and diagonal h11 agree, fixing the common branch factor. Thus Res_lambda H1=r*[[0,1],[1,0]],r=(1+i)*C*(19+30i*rho*eta)/(384*rho*n).
problems.counterexample: At a=1,q=1/2,c=27/8, r=(1-i)*(3845+304*sqrt5*i)/(35280*n), nonzero. H1 is not holomorphic and the residual is O(n^-1), not O(n^-2).
related_local_construction_issue: R1=R2*Q*R2^-1, Q=I+h11/(z-lambda)+h12/(z-lambda)^2, may have a pole at beta. In the same example, even after correcting h11, n*Res_beta(R1)_11=835/49392+31*sqrt5*i/6174 !=0.

On fixed contours separated from both endpoints, Q=I+epsilon*A,R2=I+epsilon*B yields (R1-Q)*R2=epsilon^2*[B,A], so R1-Q=O(n^-2). An endpoint Laurent residue is distinct from a fixed-contour large-n estimate.
Replacing the conjugated factor by Q changes the outer product only at O(n^-2) on those contours. This is a local repair observation, not a complete global analytic construction.
counterevidence: Changing a common square-root or gamma branch cannot correct only off-diagonals while preserving matching diagonal h11 and all h12.
The general n*[z^-1]R11=-q^2*(1-a^4*q^4)^2/[16*a*(1-q^2)*(1-a^4*q^6)^2] is exactly correct; sample=-25/1323.
At infinity the first coefficient is h11+h21; off-diagonal correction leaves its diagonal unchanged, and R2Q/QR2 cross products begin at z^-2.
No counterexample to the actual scalar free-energy coefficients or the actual polynomial asymptotic was computed. The reported defect concerns the written holomorphic-parametrix justification.
problems.impact: Major proof-construction defect: an O(n^-1) uncancelled pole invalidates the asserted analytic error problem at the precision of the central refinement(3.44). This is not a claim that Theorem3.11 or Theorem2.2 is false or unrepairable.
problems.correction_verification: Multiplying both h11 off-diagonals by i, with conjugate upper-endpoint correction, restores the checked local principal part. Complete revised global matching/invertibility/remainder proof not established.
problems.repair_status: Multiplying both h11 off-diagonals by i, with conjugate upper-endpoint correction, restores the checked local principal part. Complete revised global matching/invertibility/remainder proof not established.
